name: Musashimurayama (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Musashimurayama city emblem in white: a stylised letter V-shaped device with a disc.
history: Municipal flag of Musashimurayama, a city in Tokyo; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 3 November 1970.

features.role: Musashimurayama city emblem — a stylised letter V-shaped device with a disc
